as_told.title: Doty reportedly confessed to forging the Ellsworth document

plain: This story is about a supposed Air Force document describing an incident in November 1977 at Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota. A historian of UFOs, Richard Dolan, says the Ellsworth document has been tampered with, and that this has been traced back to Richard Doty, a man well known in UFO circles. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes the document itself: it claims that on November 16, 1977, at a site called L9, something attacked with a beam, and he mentions a researcher, Brad Sparks, in connection with it. Michels then goes further than Dolan. He says that according to a physicist and UFO researcher, Bruce Maccabee, another researcher, Bill Moore, said Doty confessed to forging the whole document. So the tellers differ on whether it was altered or made up outright. The story matters because, if genuine, the document would record an alien attack at a nuclear-era Air Force base.
